title: AI Consultant
description:
**About The E2M**
E2M Solutions works as a trusted white-label partner for digital agencies. We support agencies with consistent and reliable delivery through services such as website design, web development, eCommerce, SEO, AI SEO, PPC, AI automation, and content writing. Founded on strong business ethics, we are an equal opportunity organization powered by 300+ experienced professionals, partnering with 400+ digital agencies across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and Australia. At E2M, we value ownership, consistency, and people who are committed to doing meaningful work and growing together. If you’re someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you.
  
  
**About The Role**

* You will own AI engagements for our agency clients, from the first discovery call to live, adopted solutions. Our clients know AI matters but are held back by manual work, inconsistent AI output, and disconnected tools.
* You will find where time and money are being lost, define what to build and in what order, make sound architecture and security calls, and lead an engineering pod to ship production-ready systems. You are the person clients trust when things go right, and just as importantly, when they go wrong.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Discovery and Assessment
* Run a structured 3 to 4 week AI assessment with stakeholders across PPC, SEO, content, project management, sales, and leadership.
* Use pre-call audit sheets to quantify manual work (task, frequency, hours) and steer toward the highest-value workflows.
* Map workflows end to end (tools, handoffs, data sources, failure points) and reframe solution-first requests into the real underlying problem.
* AI Blueprint and Proposal
* Author the client AI Blueprint: 10 to 30+ use cases, each with current process, proposed solution and stack, dependencies, expected outcome, and timeline.
* Prioritise with an Impact vs. Effort matrix and recommend 2 to 3 high-impact starting automations.
* Design phased roadmaps (quick wins, leadership visibility, revenue and lead generation, then agentic systems) that build on existing tools.
* Present the plan to founders, covering team model, delivery cadence, testing approach (for example shadow mode), and pricing.
* Solution Architecture
* Lead platform, hosting, and build vs. buy decisions with client technical teams (Azure AI Foundry, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, multi-model).
* Define secure access: least privilege, read-only API scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit trails, and exclusion of sensitive data.
* Design knowledge systems: RAG pipelines, vector search trade-offs, tiered context management, MCP connectors, and reusable Claude Skills.
* Test feasibility on client APIs before scoping, manage cost-to-serve, and make deliberate "prototype now, re-architect later" calls.
* Delivery and Account Management
* Run weekly syncs per account: demo progress, collect feedback, manage change requests, and reprioritise.
* Turn feedback into clear, testable requirements for the pod and hold the line on MVP dates.
* Own AI output quality: lead root cause analysis on failures, put safe interim processes in place, and track accuracy over time.
* Lead client communication on security incidents, covering impact, actions, and timelines.
* Adoption and Training
* Train client teams through live sessions, SOPs, and follow-up coaching so solutions are used after launch.
* Ensure AI output matches each client’s brand voice and coach clients on giving feedback that improves it.
* Team Leadership
* Direct the delivery pod: set requirements, review builds, and enforce a production-ready definition of done, edge cases included.
* Mentor junior team members toward client-facing roles through frameworks, scenario reviews, and call shadowing.

**Requirements**

* Experience
* 2+ years building custom AI solutions (LLM apps, RAG, agents, workflow automation) that reached production.
* 4+ years in client-facing delivery (Project or Program Manager, Solutions Consultant, CSM, or Account Manager), ideally in an agency or services company.
* Track record of owning multiple concurrent client engagements end to end.
* Technical Skills
* AI: Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, output evaluation.
* Build: Python with FastAPI or LangGraph, MCP servers and connectors.
* Integration: APIs, webhooks, OAuth scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, secure credential handling, plus one cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and Supabase or Postgres.
* Agency stack: GA4, Search Console, Google, Meta and Bing Ads, Klaviyo, SEO data providers, HubSpot, and PM tools (Teamwork, Basecamp, ClickUp, Monday, Productive).
* Judgment: Can sketch an architecture, estimate effort, and spot feasibility risks without an engineer in the room.
* Consulting Skills
* Facilitates discovery workshops that surface the real problem.
* Quantifies ROI (hours saved, turnaround time, cost avoided) and uses it to prioritise.
* Writes clear proposals, Blueprints, requirements, and SOPs.
* Presents confidently to executives and discusses pricing, phasing, and scope in plain business language.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience productising a custom AI solution across multiple clients.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent delivery certification.
* Consulting background with exposure to process improvement and quality frameworks.
* Experience with AI search visibility, SEO intelligence, or marketing analytics.

+ Reprocessing

+ Logging
+ Monitoring
+ Reconciliation

* Greenfield SAP S/4HANA implementation experience is preferred.

title: Senior NetSuite Integration Architect
description:
**About the Company:**

Relay Human Cloud is a young & dynamic company that helps some of the top US-based companies to expand their team internationally. Relay is a truly global company having its operations in US, India, Honduras, and Mexico (We are also adding a few more countries soon). Our core focus is to enable companies to connect with the best international talent. Relay helps its clients in majorly following areas: Accounting & Finance, Administration, Operations, Space Planning, Leasing, Data Science, Data Search, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence etc. Relay India operates from Ahmedabad and Vadodara offices. The principals and founders of Relay Human Cloud have been focused on delivering high-quality operations in cutting-edge companies for their entire careers.

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Manager – Enterprise Integration & Data Architecture with strong NetSuite integration expertise to design, develop, and maintain enterprise integrations, APIs, EDI, and data pipelines. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills and a solid understanding of distribution, inventory, order processing, and accounting workflows. This role focuses on hands-on implementation, troubleshooting, and long-term technical ownership rather than project management.

**Responsibilities:**

**Enterprise integration architecture**

* Design and maintain the company's enterprise integration architecture, including approved patterns for APIs, EDI, webhooks, SFTP, files, native connectors, events, and batch processing.
* Define source and target systems, authoritative data boundaries, field mappings, timing, sequencing, validation, error handling, retry, reconciliation, security, and support ownership for each interface.
* Avoid uncontrolled point-to-point connections, duplicated business logic, and integrations that create parallel systems of record.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, interface inventories, mapping specifications, decision records, and runbooks while determining which existing interfaces should be retained, redesigned, replaced, or retired.

**NetSuite integration engineering**

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support integrations between NetSuite and internal or external systems.
* Develop deep knowledge of the NetSuite record, transaction, permission, and posting models so interfaces create valid operational and accounting results.
* Work with applicable NetSuite capabilities such as REST web services, SuiteTalk, RESTlets, SuiteScript, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, web services, and token-based authentication.
* Use Oracle integration technologies where appropriate, establish reusable engineering patterns, and challenge partner-proposed designs before owning the deployed solution and support model.

**Customer vendor and external ecosystem integration**

* Support EDI and API connectivity for customers, broadline distributors, vendors, logistics providers, marketplaces, payment services, websites, and other business partners.
* Design mappings and workflows for relevant documents such as purchase orders, acknowledgments, advance ship notices, invoices, inventory updates, item data, pricing, and order status.
* Support vendor onboarding, customer enablement, item synchronization, pricing exchange, order ingestion, fulfillment status, and other digital transaction flows while keeping partner-specific rules documented and controlled.
* Build repeatable onboarding patterns that reduce the cost and time required to connect new customers, vendors, and acquisitions.

**Data architecture ownership and governance**

* Help define company's enterprise data architecture with NetSuite as the authoritative transactional platform for the processes it owns.
* Establish clear boundaries for transactional, master, analytical, historical, reference, and external application data.
* Partner with business and application owners to define authoritative sources, data ownership, approval rights, stewardship, quality rules, and lifecycle requirements.
* Design governed data pipelines, transformation logic, shared definitions, and reconciliations so critical item, pricing, costing, inventory, margin, customer, vendor, and financial logic remains transparent and auditable.

**Legacy discovery migration and transition**

* Inspect legacy applications, databases, scripts, interfaces, files, and automated jobs to identify embedded business rules and technical dependencies.
* Document why existing functionality exists before replacing it, separating requirements that must be preserved from obsolete workarounds and technical debt.
* Support extraction, transformation, mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation, and reconciliation with repeatable utilities and control totals that preserve financial, operational, and referential integrity.
* Plan retirement, archival, access, and support arrangements for legacy data and applications that will not move into the future environment.

**Analytics data services and application enablement**

* Support the architecture and ongoing operation of NetSuite Analytics Warehouse and related analytics capabilities where adopted.
* Define the appropriate roles of NetSuite native reporting, governed analytical platforms, Power BI, and other reporting tools so business logic is not recreated inconsistently.
* Design data models and pipelines that provide trusted reporting and reconcile to source transactions.
* Support approved extension platforms for internal tools, portals, and workflows, and enable automation or AI only through governed data, controlled interfaces, clear ownership, and appropriate human review.

**Testing monitoring security and operational support**

* Develop and execute unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, failure-mode, cutover, and reconciliation testing with documented acceptance criteria.
* Implement logging, automated alerts, transaction tracing, exception queues, retry mechanisms, dashboards, and escalation procedures so failures are visible and actionable.
* Perform hands-on production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across systems, data, network, authentication, mapping, sequencing, and business-rule layers.
* Apply secure access and data protection while establishing standards for source control, code review, automated testing, environment separation, deployment, versioning, rollback, documentation, and change control.

**Long term architecture ownership**

* Become a primary internal owner for enterprise integrations, data pipelines, interface standards, and supporting technical documentation.
* Work side by side with implementation-partner engineers during design and build activities rather than receiving knowledge only at the end of the program.
* Build internal support capability, reduce unnecessary dependence on external consultants, and prioritize technical debt and enhancements based on business value, reliability, control risk, total cost, and operational impact.
* Create scalable patterns that support growth, acquisition integration, customer and vendor enablement, analytics, automation, and future digital services

**Qualifications:**

* More than 7 years of enterprise application integration, software engineering, data engineering, or related technical experience.
* Meaningful hands-on experience integrating with NetSuite and working with its records, transactions, permissions, APIs, or scripting capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of REST and SOAP services, JSON, XML, SQL, SFTP, webhooks, authentication, and modern integration patterns.
* Experience designing, building, testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production integrations and data pipelines.
* Experience with data mapping, transformation, migration, reconciliation, master data, and data-quality controls.
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis skills across applications, interfaces, data, security, and business processes.
* Experience with API security, token-based authentication, source control, code review, testing, deployment, environment management, and operational documentation.
* Ability to understand order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory, fulfillment, and accounting impacts in addition to technical specifications.
* Ability to evaluate and challenge consultant or vendor recommendations and assume ownership of the resulting design.
* Strong written communication and willingness to remain hands-on throughout implementation and long-term operation of the environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), NetSuite Integration Platform, and other Oracle integration technologies.
* Experience with SuiteTalk, SuiteScript, RESTlets, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, or NetSuite Analytics Warehouse.
* Knowledge of EDI standards and third-party integration processes.
* Experience in food distribution, wholesale distribution, retail, logistics, or other transaction-intensive industries.
* Experience modernizing Microsoft Dynamics GP or custom legacy applications.
* Familiarity with Oracle APEX, Power BI, cloud data platforms, workflow automation, or document processing.
* Experience with multi-entity environments, acquisitions, and high-volume order and inventory transactions.

**Why Join Relay Human Cloud? ✨**

🌍 Opportunities to work with global clients

🤝 Dynamic and collaborative work environment

⚖️ Excellent work-life balance – 5-day workweek

🩺 Comprehensive health & accident insurance

🌴 Generous paid time off and holidays

🍽️ Complimentary lunches & dinners

🏆 Quarterly, Semi-Annual & Annual recognition, rewards, and giveaways

📚 Employee development programs – Communication, Soft Skills, and more

🎉 Vibrant cultural events – Fun Fridays, Month-End Celebrations, Sports Tournaments, and Festival celebrations

🎯 Excellent Employee Referral Program

**5) Improve What Exists**

* Suggest better alternatives, challenge weak designs, and take part in product and technical decisions.
* Grow into mentoring junior developers and leading technical direction for your squad.

**Must-Have:**

* 1-2 years of experience building and shipping real software.
* Hands-on skills in React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript on the frontend, and in Node.js or Python on the backend with relational and non-relational databases.

* The ability to explain your decisions and the alternatives you considered.
* An understanding of what changes when software serves lakhs of users: failure handling, performance, and security.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience with AWS services such as EC2, RDS, SES, SNS, SQS, DynamoDB, Lambda, etc.
* Experience integrating third-party systems: payment gateways, messaging platforms, CRM tools.

* Familiarity with AngularJS, PHP (CodeIgniter), FastAPI, or Cordova.
* GitHub repositories, personal projects, or scripts that show your coding habits.

We hire engineers who want to lead. Here is the path we expect you to take.

1. **First 3 months:**

   get productive in our stack and deliver your first impactful projects. You start owning the architecture and code quality of your own work in your first quarter.
2. **By 6 months:**

   full ownership of your own architecture and code, shipping projects at a steady pace.
3. **By 12 months:**

   you own your squad's architecture and code quality, not only your own. You mentor junior developers, suggest new initiatives, and work closely with your Product Owner.

AlmaShines, founded by 3 IIT Kanpur alumni, is India's largest and fastest-growing community management platform, trusted by 2,000+ institutes and used by over 1 crore users, with 4 lakh+ active users across 15+ countries every month. We help institutions, organizations, NGOs, and professional networks build meaningful communities through robust technology, smart automation, and tailor-made configurations.

Website:
www.almashines.io

  a live platform with 1 crore+ users means your work has direct, visible impact
* **Ownership from day one:**

Medical insurance and wellness perks

24 paid leaves per year

High-growth environment with ownership, learning, and meaningful impact

If that sounds like you, this is the perfect place for you.

 logs, traces, time\-series storage and enjoys owning a module end to end. This is a high\-ownership role in a

 development as a daily tool, and be accountable for what you ship in production.

 Build and scale services for operational data ingestion, enrichment, storage, and query in a

 discovery and inventory data.

 stores.

 downstream consumers see one shape regardless of source.

 model inference into the ingestion and query path within latency and resource budgets.

 model, interfaces, scaling limits, failure modes, and rollback.

 while retaining full ownership of correctness, security, and design quality of the generated
 



 output.

 to design and engineering documentation.

 • Continuously learn and apply modern development practices and tools.

**•** 
 B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT

 ability and appetite to work in Rust.

 monitoring systems, or telemetry pipelines.

 communication, and the standard distributed failure modes (partial failure, backpressure, retries,
 



 idempotency).

 percentiles, drift) and the ability to implement a detection algorithm from a specification or paper.

 risks early, and does not treat a handoff as the end of responsibility

 • Supports tens of thousands of recurring subscriptions each month alongside high\-volume clinical and pharmacy workflows.

 Healthcare experience is not required. Experience building genuinely complex software is.

 • Backend services and business logic using Node.js, NestJS and TypeScript.

**MULTI\-TENANT SAAS EXPERIENCE** 




 Multi\-tenant SaaS experience is a core requirement for this role.
 



 We are looking for candidates who have actually developed a production product used by multiple customer organisations.
 



 You should have experience with:
 



 • A shared product and codebase used by multiple tenants/customers.
 



 • Tenant\-aware data access or isolation.

 • Customer\-specific behaviour without creating a completely separate product for every client.

 • Production releases where changes needed to remain compatible with existing customers.

**AI\-FIRST ENGINEERING** 




 We are looking for engineers whose development workflow has materially changed because of AI.
 



 AI should be a regular implementation tool, not something used only occasionally to explain an error.
 



 You will use AI to:
 



 • Understand – Inspect unfamiliar modules, trace code paths and understand existing patterns.
 



 • Plan – Break requirements into implementation steps, identify dependencies and consider edge cases.
 



 • Implement – Generate substantial implementation work rather than manually typing routine code.
 



 • Test – Create and extend unit, integration and edge\-case test coverage.
 



 • Debug – Analyse errors, logs, failing tests and unfamiliar execution paths.
 



 • Verify – Review diffs, run tests and validate behaviour yourself.
 



 AI output is never accepted blindly. You remain accountable for the quality, correctness and maintainability of your work.
 



**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




 • 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience.
 



 • 2\+ years of hands\-on production Node.js development.
 



 • 2\+ years of production React / React.js development.
 



 • 2\+ years of production TypeScript development.
 



 • Real experience building a multi\-tenant SaaS product.
 



 • Strong understanding of backend business logic, APIs, databases and production debugging.
 



 • Experience owning features end\-to\-end rather than only implementing small isolated tickets.
 



 • Clear written and spoken English.
 



 • Strong AI\-assisted engineering experience across planning, implementation, testing and debugging.
 



**NICE TO HAVE** 




 • NestJS, Express or Fastify.
 



 • PostgreSQL, MongoDB or another production database.
 



 • Redis, queues, background jobs or event\-driven processing.
 



 • REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks and third\-party integrations.

**WHY JOIN SCRIPT ASSIST?** 




 • Build on a live multi\-tenant SaaS platform where your work reaches real customers quickly.
